about: CO₂ extinguishers put out Class B and electrical fires by displacing oxygen and cooling. They leave no residue, which makes them a good choice for server rooms, control panels and laboratories.
Use them in ventilated spaces and hold the horn by its handle, as it becomes very cold. CO₂ extinguishers are weighed during inspection to check the charge.
